package.name: bev_pose
package.description:
bev_pose: 6D object pose estimation using NVlabs/FoundationPose.
Provides: * foundationpose_node — RGB + Depth + CameraInfo + object_mask → /perception/object_pose * object_mask_node — P0 single-object initialization helper (ROI + depth threshold) * mesh_preprocessor — offline OBJ → vertices / bbox / diameter .npz * orbbec_gemini2.launch.py — Orbbec Gemini 2 RGB-D bringup (serial_number first)
Topic map (primary): in : /perception/cameras/front/{image, depth, camera_info} in : /perception/object_mask (mono8 0/255) out: /perception/object_pose (geometry_msgs/PoseStamped) out: /perception/object_poses_3d (vision_msgs/Detection3DArray) [optional] out: /tf (camera_frame → object_frame) out: /perception/mesh_meta (precomputed mesh metadata for visualizer)
Requirements: * NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin (or any GPU that runs NVlabs/FoundationPose) * PyTorch + nvdiffrast.torch (see FoundationPose README) * trimesh (for offline preprocessing) * orbbec_camera ROS2 driver (for the camera bringup)
